As the envoy to a powerful king, you are sent to the mysterious frontier of the Living Lands. The locals speak of a soul-plague known as the Dreamscourge, and it is up to you to find out what it is at its root. This untamed island is home to exiles, dreamers, and adventurers alike, and it is up to you to decide their fate. Build your own character from five different races and five unique backgrounds. Write your own narrative through action and words. Challenge enemies with sword, bow, wand, gun, spell or mix to your heart's desire. Arriving complete with a year's worth of updates that bring new features like New Game Plus, Photo Mode, custom game options, and arachnophobia mode, Avowed is available now for PlayStation 5!
